purpose: Controlled V2 Fixed vs V3 Fixed development benchmark focused on physical instrument realism, anti-repetitive percussion, phrase continuity, and A/B consistency.

cases.prompt: Jazz Fusion, 170 BPM, E minor, live acoustic drums, electric bass, Rhodes piano, saxophone and electric guitar; natural human groove, expressive phrasing, realistic drum articulation, no repetitive machine-like percussion.
Funk, 112 BPM, E minor, live drums, slap bass, clavinet, brass accents and clean guitar; human pocket, ghost notes, dynamic accents, natural instrument resonance and no static repeated drum pattern.
Alternative Rock, 132 BPM, D major, live drum kit, bass guitar, two electric guitars; realistic drummer dynamics, natural fills, guitar articulation, bass interaction and evolving band performance.
Soul, 92 BPM, A minor, acoustic drums, electric bass, Rhodes, clean guitar and brass section; expressive human timing, breathing room, dynamic phrases and realistic acoustic articulation.

Modern Jazz, 138 BPM, C minor, acoustic drum kit, upright bass, piano and tenor saxophone; natural swing, drummer interaction, breath-shaped sax phrasing, piano dynamics and realistic ensemble interplay.

Chamber ensemble, 84 BPM, G minor, violin, viola, cello, double bass, clarinet and French horn; natural bow changes, breath phrasing, realistic legato, dynamic articulation and acoustic room resonance.
